Western Zone swim team collection

Prepared proposals; live status is in Import review. No batch was approved by this collector. Sources checked October 10, 2026.

694 proposed teams/programs across 16 LSCs, plus 19 existing Inland Empire teams. All 17 Western LSCs are represented. Current membership coverage remains partial.

Grouped into 18 LSC batches. Missing fields, historical registration evidence, and source conflicts appear directly on each card.
